title: Record, index and package improvement experience
scenario: Scenario: improvement-experience. Capture on the #81 candidate (stacked on #80). Python 3.11+, a disposable home and synthetic case and records; no model call.

steps.title: Find the candidate step and its CLI
steps.instruction: Open docs/map/index.html and select 3. Prepare a minimal candidate. Its usage points to scripts/improvement/experience.py index and the store guide. Read the loop's Learn from earlier attempts section for the rules before recording anything.
steps.caption: Actual local map detail for the candidate step. The CLI is manual; nothing runs automatically.
steps.expected: The candidate author reads a frozen index of reusable experience first and opens entries selectively. Rules live in the loop design; the map only points to them.

steps.title: Record, review, index and package
steps.instruction: Pipe one experience JSON to experience.py add (edit rows, NO_ENTRY lesson, exposure, scope, cycle). Review it as reusable with its exact digest. Freeze the index for the next cycle and scope. Build a package from an exported case, baseline and candidate trees, results and the index, using a new absolute output directory.
steps.caption: Browser-rendered summary of actual CLI results in a disposable home; digests shortened and temporary paths replaced with $TMP.
steps.expected: The held-out record never enters the index. The package excludes .answers/key.json, keeps the trajectory when rendering is missing, lists gaps and marks unknown cost. An existing output is refused, and revoking the grant empties the index. A stable digest for unchanged inputs is checked by the tests, not by this capture.
